review_boundary.purpose: Define an explicit bridge from adaptive candidate identity to a complete executable G3BCandidate representation.
review_boundary.scope: Non-holdout design review only; no candidate payloads are created and no runner is implemented.

other_approved_non_holdout_sources.finding: No complete candidate source keyed by the adaptive case identity was found in the approved non-holdout artifacts/code inspected.

candidate_identity_binding.reason: Each adaptive identity binds to a structural metadata record, but no complete executable candidate representation is present or referenced. The current fingerprint cannot validate an executable candidate payload.

fingerprint_scope.current_declared_scope: SHA-256 structural fingerprint emitted by package.ts
fingerprint_scope.actual_current_input: canonical partial object containing partition, source_id, claim_family, and contradiction_score
fingerprint_scope.prohibited_action: Do not silently repurpose existing case_fingerprint values for a complete executable candidate representation.
fingerprint_scope.required_human_definition: Choose and freeze whether a replacement or extended fingerprint binds the complete candidate payload or a canonical immutable source representation. Existing fingerprints must remain historically interpreted.

canonicalization_requirements.field_ordering: sorted object keys recursively; must be frozen by human decision
canonicalization_requirements.null_handling: candidate schema currently has nullability none; any null policy must be explicit
canonicalization_requirements.arrays: preserve declared array order; no unordered-set interpretation unless explicitly frozen
canonicalization_requirements.strings: UTF-8 exact strings; no normalization unless explicitly frozen
canonicalization_requirements.numbers: finite numeric representation with frozen serialization; no runtime-dependent formatting
canonicalization_requirements.current_runtime_canonicalizer: package.ts canonical() sorts object keys and preserves array order, but current candidate fingerprints do not cover complete candidate fields

alternative_a_frozen_full_candidate_arti.definition: Create a new frozen candidate-space artifact containing complete G3BCandidate objects plus identity and a fingerprint over the complete canonical representation.
risks: requires defining every currently unresolved field
alternative_a_frozen_full_candidate_arti.runner_behavior: load exact object by candidate identity, validate complete-payload fingerprint, then evaluate

alternative_b_frozen_identity_to_source_.definition: Retain adaptive identity entries and add immutable references to already existing complete candidate sources; validate referenced source and complete-payload fingerprint before evaluation.
advantages: strong provenance if source is stable
risks: no qualifying complete adaptive source currently exists
depends on stable source identity and lifecycle
requires exact reference and fingerprint semantics
alternative_b_frozen_identity_to_source_.runner_behavior: resolve candidate_id to frozen source reference, load exact existing G3BCandidate, validate fingerprint, then evaluate

alternative_c_deterministic_constructor.definition: Freeze a deterministic materialize(case_id, frozen_sources) function only after every field derivation, source, constraint, and canonical fingerprint input is explicitly defined.
risks: easy to introduce hidden defaults or inference
must not derive from evaluator/oracle outcomes
alternative_c_deterministic_constructor.runner_behavior: invoke only the frozen constructor, validate complete-payload fingerprint, then evaluate

provenance_and_replay_implications.required_identity: case_id plus exact fingerprint plus fixture binding
provenance_and_replay_implications.required_materialization_evidence: source artifact or constructor version/hash and complete candidate payload hash
provenance_and_replay_implications.required_replay: same identity, source/version, canonical payload, evaluator input, and output across repeated runs
provenance_and_replay_implications.authority_boundary: Materialization must not mutate execution authority, governance configuration, other arms, other fixtures, seeds, regimes, or trajectories.

recommendation.basis: Evidence establishes the gap but does not justify selecting A, B, or C. Software must not make this semantic choice.
